title: Deployment and Operations
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of deployment and operations using at least one correct term from the lesson.

Identify one relevant edge case, debugging step, or version/platform constraint.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Deployment and Operations** as part of **Kotlin for Backend and Server-Side Development**. A server endpoint should validate input, apply authorization at the server boundary, return consistent status codes, and be covered by tests and operational monitoring. Use the subtopics—Environment Configuration, Containerization and Hosting, Health Checks, Logging, and Monitoring—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Backend code handles untrusted requests and persistent data. Validation, authorization, predictable errors, and operational checks must happen on the server.
